message.runtimeUnavailable: Runtime is unavailable for this request.
message.inputInvalid: The request needs a valid prompt or required input before it can run.
message.sdkMethodUnavailable: This capability is not available in the current app build.
message.principalUnauthorized: Runtime rejected the protected owner for this request.
message.runtimeTimeout: This Runtime generation reached its terminal timeout.
message.runtimeCallFailed: Runtime could not complete this generation.

action.runtimeUnavailable: Start or reconnect Runtime, then try again.
action.inputInvalid: Review the prompt and required fields, then run it again.
action.sdkMethodUnavailable: Update the app or switch to a supported capability.
action.principalUnauthorized: Restore the protected App session, then retry.
action.runtimeCanceled: Run the request again when you are ready.
action.runtimeTimeout: Review the timeout cause, then retry when the Runtime or provider can complete the request.
action.runtimeCallFailed: Inspect the typed Runtime error, then retry after resolving its cause.
action.fallback: Check Runtime details for diagnostics, then try again.

hint.runtimeUnavailable: Restore the protected Runtime connection, then retry the same request.
hint.inputInvalid: Supply a valid request body for this capability, then retry.
hint.sdkMethodUnavailable: Add an admitted SDK Nimi App execution method. Do not bypass Runtime with app-local REST.
hint.principalUnauthorized: Runtime rejected the protected owner identity. Restore the admitted App session before retrying.
hint.runtimeCanceled: Runtime durably canceled this ScenarioJob. Submit a new request only when another run is wanted.
hint.runtimeTimeout: Runtime durably timed out this ScenarioJob. Inspect its typed reason and trace before retrying.
hint.runtimeCallFailed: Runtime returned a typed contract failure. Inspect the verbatim Runtime error without inferring success.
